### Meaning
| infl. | class | meaning                                                                                                                          |
| ----- | ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*  | **long and straight object**: stick, rod, bar, pole, beam, pillar, staff; straight line (in 2D geometry); hyphen, dash (in text) |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
Meant to be the simple shape of a rod, but stylized to be pillar-like.
#### Meaning
toki pona "palisa"
#### Sound
- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Concepts/den\|den]] (straight) and [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Man-made/le\|le]] (line/thread)
- *a priori:* d=hard/straight, e=connective
